info.description: ## API for the API Connect Engagement system

/{analytics-service}/orgs/{org}/engageme.description: Return the supported engagement configuration at provider organization scope.

get.summary: Engagement configuration supported at provider organization scope
get.description: Return the supported engagement configuration at provider organization scope.

/{analytics-service}/orgs/{org}/anomaly-.description: Return anomaly detectors for a provider organization.

get.summary: List anomaly detectors at provider organization scope
get.description: Returns all anomaly detectors belonging to a provider organization.

post.summary: Create an anomaly detector at provider organization scope
post.description: Creates a new anomaly detector for the provider organization. Use detector_type "latency" or "traffic-volume" to provision a pre-built detector, or omit detector_type to supply a fully custom configuration.

/{analytics-service}/orgs/{org}/anomaly-.description: Create a pre-configured anomaly detector from a built-in template.

post.summary: Create an anomaly detector from a template
post.description: Creates an anomaly detector using a pre-built template. The detectorType path parameter must be one of "latency", "traffic-volume", or "api-event-volume".

/{analytics-service}/orgs/{org}/anomaly-.description: Validate anomaly detector configuration against OpenSearch before creation.

post.description: Runs a pre-flight check using the OpenSearch Anomaly Detection _validate/model endpoint. Returns validation errors without creating a detector.

/{analytics-service}/orgs/{org}/anomaly-.description: Retrieve, update, or delete a single anomaly detector.

get.description: Returns a single anomaly detector.

post.description: Starts a stopped or newly created anomaly detector.

/{analytics-service}/orgs/{org}/rules.description: Return a result set of engagement rules.

/{analytics-service}/orgs/{org}/rules/to.description: Returns the total count of all engagement rules within a specific organization.

detector-id.description: Anomaly detector ID. This ID is globally unique across the analytics service.

detector-type.description: Built-in anomaly detector type. Supported values: "latency", "traffic-volume", "api-event-volume".

task-id.name: task-id
task-id.description: Engagement task ID. This ID is globally unique across the analytics service.

end_date_optional.name: end
end_date_optional.description: If set, only return items with a datetime equal or older than this. The date-time value should be in ISO format. For example, 2021-07-21T00:00:000Z.

force_optional.name: force
force_optional.description: Force delete a destination even if it is in use by other rules.

limit_optional.name: limit
limit_optional.description: If set, the number of items to return when requesting a list. Maximum: 500

offset_optional.name: offset
offset_optional.description: If set, the offset to be applied when requesting a list. e.g. return events starting from the 100th result

ruleid_optional.name: rule-id
ruleid_optional.description: Engagement rule ID. This ID is globally unique across the analytics service.

search_optional.name: search
search_optional.description: Search for an item by name or description.

start_date_optional.name: start
start_date_optional.description: If set, only return items with a datetime equal or newer than this. The date-time value should be in ISO format. For example, 2021-07-21T00:00:000Z.

accept_language_optional.name: accept-language
accept_language_optional.description: Natural language and locale that the client prefers.

message.description: The contents to send to the desired destination (used for all destination types)

target.description: HTTP(S) URL for webhook destinations (only used for webhook destinations)

header_params.description: HTTP header parameters for webhook destinations (only used for webhook destinations)

method.description: HTTP method for webhook destinations (only used for webhook destinations)
